sn51.20:11.2: It’s when energy is coupled with laziness.
sn51.20:12.1: And what is energy that’s too tense?
sn51.20:12.2: It’s when energy is coupled with restlessness.
sn51.20:13.1: And what is energy that’s constricted internally?
sn51.20:13.2: It’s when energy is coupled with dullness and drowsiness.
sn51.20:13.3: This is called energy constricted internally.
sn51.20:14.1: And what is energy that’s scattered externally?
sn51.20:14.2: It’s when energy is frequently scattered and diffused externally on account of the five kinds of sensual stimulation. This is called energy scattered externally. …
sn51.20:15.1: And how, with an open and unenveloped heart, does a mendicant develop a mind that’s full of radiance?
sn51.20:15.2: It’s when a mendicant has properly grasped the perception of light, and has properly grasped the perception of day.
sn51.20:15.3: That’s how, with an open and unenveloped heart, a mendicant develops a mind that’s full of radiance.
sn51.20:16.2: It’s when mental development is coupled with laziness.
sn51.20:16.3: This is called lax mental development.
sn51.20:17.1: And what is mental development that’s too tense?
sn51.20:17.2: It’s when mental development is coupled with restlessness.
sn51.20:17.3: This is called tense mental development.
sn51.20:18.1: And what is mental development that’s constricted internally?
sn51.20:18.2: It’s when mental development is coupled with dullness and drowsiness.
sn51.20:18.3: This is called mental development constricted internally.
sn51.20:19.1: And what is mental development that’s scattered externally?
sn51.20:19.2: It’s when mental development is frequently scattered and diffused externally on account of the five kinds of sensual stimulation.
sn51.20:19.3: This is called mental development scattered externally. …
sn51.20:19.4: That’s how, with an open and unenveloped heart, a mendicant develops a mind that’s full of radiance.
